name: Memory Save
description: Store preferences, credentials (safe tags), paths, or key-value entries in Jacx memory.

name: Memory Read
description: Retrieve previously saved preferences or values from memory.

name: Memory Update
description: Modify or overwrite existing memory keys and settings.

name: Preferred Browser Search
description: Web searches using the user's saved/preferred browser from memory.

name: Explicit Browser Search
description: Web searches targeting a specific named browser (e.g. Brave, Chrome, Edge).

name: General Web Search
description: Standard queries intended for default web search engine without browser reference.

name: Platform Search
description: Searches targeted at specific web platforms (e.g., YouTube, GitHub, StackOverflow).

name: Local File Search
description: Locate files, documents, or directories on the local machine.

name: File Creation
description: Generate or create new local files, scripts, or documents.

name: Prompt Generation
description: Produce targeted AI system/refactoring prompts for OpenCode or Antigravity.

name: Planning & Reasoning
description: Multi-step architectural designs, system plans, or step-by-step reasoning.

name: Task Context Follow-up
description: Follow-up questions or modifications that rely on previous task context.

name: Skill Listing
description: Display currently available, learned, or pending skills.

name: Skill Creation
description: Teach Jacx new command patterns or skill definitions.

name: Skill Approval
description: Review and approve pending user or system skills.

name: Approved Skill Execution
description: Execute a previously defined and approved skill pattern.

name: Status & Debug Commands
description: System status, memory debug, router state, or cloud brain status lookups.

name: Response Pipeline Tests
description: Local application launches, basic pipeline commands, and core routing.

name: OmniRoute & Cloud Fallback
description: Complex or ambiguous queries requiring multi-model reasoning or cloud brain.

name: Unsupported or Vague Commands
description: Gibberish, unsupported requests, or ambiguous single-word commands.

name: Safety Blocked Commands
description: Commands involving credentials, unsafe shell commands, or destructive actions.
